summary: Iteration 14 — verified two user-reported production bugs are fixed. (1) PaymentBox no longer returns null when /api/payments/settings has manual_enabled=false AND crypto_enabled=false: the box still renders with the Cashfree tab/CTA. (2) notify_quote_sent renders flat Gmail-safe HTML body (no nested <table> inside body div) and contains the required markers 'QUOTE TOTAL', 'Payment options', and CTA url ending '&pay=1'. All 7 new tests pass + full iter9/10/12/13 regression (52/52) pass.
critical_code_review_comments: PaymentBox.jsx line 51 still has `if (!cf.configured && !anyManual) return null;` — this is safe in current state because the backend's `_ensure_payment_settings` always seeds defaults, but the safeSettings fallback no longer triggers null. The remaining guard is intentional (no payment method at all) and is fine.

OrderIn pydantic model has no `amount`/`payment_amount` field — admins can only set order pricing via the recovery `send-payment` flow or by direct DB write. Acceptable since the recovery flow is the documented quoting path, but a generic admin PATCH for order pricing would be a useful enhancement.

email_service._wrap still uses tables for the outer chrome (header/CTA/footer) — that's standard for email clients and not affected by the Gmail strip behavior reported. The fix correctly removed nested tables only from the body content.

Frontend OrderDetail relies on customer-side `api.getOrder(id)` which is GET /api/orders/{id} — currently unauthenticated (anyone with the order id can fetch). Not in scope of this bug but flagging for future hardening.

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_iter14 recovery cases and tear them down via DELETE /api/recovery/cases/{id}. payment_settings is toggled and restored to default within each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend headless flow uses API-set cookie (httpOnly eh_session is auto-set by /api/auth/login) — no UI login needed for /me/orders/{id}. UI login form selectors are non-standard; if needed, locate via the page's specific data-testid. Iter14 test file covers: payment_settings non-null contract, cashfree=production, PUT admin toggle, notify_quote_sent flat-HTML, recovery send-payment linked-order creation, and customer /me/orders shape.

rca of the issue.bug_1: PaymentBox.jsx had `if (!settings) return null;` after the useEffect — when /api/payments/settings was unreachable or threw, settings stayed null and the entire box rendered nothing, hiding the Cashfree CTA too. Fix replaces with `safeSettings` fallback ({manual_enabled:false, crypto_enabled:false, crypto_wallets:[], ...}) so the Cashfree pane always renders when cf.configured=true.
